summary: 38 units reviewed. Issues: 6 error, 27 minor. Main problems: particles dropped in one language (ca in 29 Hindi, hi in 32 Hindi, eva in 6/9 English), vā rendered 'और/nor' in 4, glossary non-conformities (anuśaya bracket in 2, anyatra in 5, 'tasya-atikrame' in 16, closing label in 17), added words in Hindi (तो, बात, उसके, और, स्वामी), unit 17 marker glossing/flag/GROUPING as ch01 unit 16, unit 28 corrected form not used in w. No unmatched quote in the e-text. No regrouping suggested. Hand edits (word entries) are listed in the report: unit 3 split of tasya.
